statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let m := fun (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (s.indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2), ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range (q+1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), m {t : ℝ | (Q n:ℝ)^2/(n:ℝ) < |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)|} (fun t => 4*(n:ℝ)^2 / ((Nat.totient q:ℝ)^2*(1+((n:ℝ)*(t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))^2)))) ≤ ε*(n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 同时截去全部有理峰远端，误差为 o(n)
plain_statement.en: Cut all rational-peak tails simultaneously at sublinear cost

brief.zh: 共同半径为 Q²/n。用洛伦兹尾积分、每个分母至多 2φ(q) 个分子，以及 ∑_{q≤Q²}1/φ(q)≤4Q，得到全体尾部至多 64πn/Q。包括 q=1 的两个端点。
brief.en: At common radius Q²/n, Lorentz integration, at most 2φ(q) centers and a reciprocal-totient sum ≤4Q give total leakage ≤64πn/Q. Both endpoints for q=1 are included.
